LESSON: DRESSING ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL
Topic 1.5: Dressing ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Dressing ENVIRONMENT
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What clothes do people wear ENVIRONMENT learners should be able to; identify clothes worn at at home?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT
2. give Kenyan examples of Dressing ENVIRONMENT
3. practise a safe skill for Dressing ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Dressing ENVIRONMENT

Teach
• Observe Dressing ENVIRONMENT in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Dressing ENVIRONMENT (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Dressing ENVIRONMENT: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What clothes do people wear ENVIRONMENT learners should be able to; identify clothes worn at at home?
2. What clothes do you wear at occasions. during different occasions. different occasions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Dressing ENVIRONMENT with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
